detailed_description: The Data URI Generator reads one selected file in the browser with FileReader and outputs the resulting data URI string. After choosing a file, the tool shows the file name, size, and browser-provided MIME type, displays the generated data URI in a readonly textarea, lets you copy it, and shows an image preview when the result starts with an image data URI. It uses the browser's readAsDataURL behavior and does not provide custom encoding modes, MIME editing, charset settings, or file-size optimization.
usage_steps: Click the upload area and select a file from your device.
Review the displayed file name, size, and MIME type when available.
Copy the generated data URI from the output textarea.
Use Clear when you want to reset the selected file and output.
usage_examples: Convert a small image file to a data URI and preview it in the browser.
Copy a generated data URI for a quick HTML or CSS experiment.
Check the browser-reported MIME type and file size before copying the output.
Clear the current selection and generate a data URI for another file.
